 HELLO, LITTLE EXPLORER

Meet a little possibility.

Momo is an interactive wish companion. Share a goal, refine your preferences, save options and try a sandbox checkout with an animated little explorer.

AI chat connects to DeepSeek and web search through the backend. The guided catalog uses fictional people, products, prices and time slots. Checkout uses PayPal Sandbox and does not create real bookings or deliveries.
